view.scene_description: A modern, well-lit interior space resembling a library or café with large windows on the left. A prominent spiral bookshelf tower stands centrally, illuminated from within. People sit at tables working or reading. The background reveals more shelving and architectural elements, suggesting a multi-level design.

objects.label: spiral bookshelf
objects.observation: A tall, cylindrical bookshelf with concentric circular shelves, glowing with internal lighting. It is positioned centrally in the room, surrounded by seating areas. Books are arranged on its shelves. Appears freestanding.

objects.label: person sitting
objects.observation: An individual wearing dark clothing, seated at a table near the spiral bookshelf. They appear to be focused on a laptop or book. Their legs are crossed, and they are partially obscured by another person.

objects.label: person sitting
objects.observation: Another individual, wearing light-colored clothing, seated at the same table as person 2. They are also engaged with a device, possibly a laptop. Partially obscured by person 2.

objects.label: large window
objects.observation: A wide expanse of glass windows along the left wall, allowing natural light to flood the room. Trees and outdoor structures are visible through them. The frame is dark and vertical.

objects.label: table
objects.observation: A long wooden table where people are seated. It has a smooth surface and is positioned in front of the spiral bookshelf. Several chairs are placed around it.

objects.label: chairs
objects.observation: Multiple metal-framed chairs with blue seats are arranged around the table. Some are occupied, others empty. They have thin legs and are positioned at various angles.

objects.label: laptop
objects.observation: A laptop computer on the table, being used by one of the seated individuals. Its screen is lit, indicating active use. Positioned directly in front of the user.

objects.label: backpack
objects.observation: A black backpack resting on the floor next to one of the seated individuals. It is positioned under the table, near their feet.

objects.label: book
objects.observation: A single book visible on the lower shelf of the spiral bookshelf. It has a red cover and is placed upright among other books.

objects.label: ceiling structure
objects.observation: The ceiling features exposed beams and recessed lighting fixtures. It appears to be part of a larger architectural design, possibly with decorative elements.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "thud_agtea_test50/image-000006", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
